'''Kanarosiku-K''' was a [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] research [[Droid/Legends|droid]] stationed aboard by the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Gray Secant]]''. It recruited outsiders to reestablish communications with various research droids scattered throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
